subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Unity Mural is an artwork by Layla Khoury and Jordan Foster.
• It is a large-scale mural depicting interconnected hands of different colors.
• It is on display on a public library wall in Austin, Texas.
• The Neighborhood Watch is a work of art by Diego Ruiz.
• It is a colorful mural showing people of various ages looking out windows.
• It is on display on a public community center wall in Portland, Oregon.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between The Unity Mural and The Neighborhood Watch. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Neighborhood Watch, a colorful mural showing people of various ages looking out windows, is on display on a public community center wall.
choices.B: The Unity Mural, but not The Neighborhood Watch, can be found in Austin, Texas.
choices.C: Both The Unity Mural and The Neighborhood Watch were created by Layla Khoury and Jordan Foster.
choices.D: The Unity Mural and The Neighborhood Watch are both displayed in public spaces.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it effectively emphasizes a similarity between the two artworks. According to the notes, The Unity Mural is displayed on a public library wall and The Neighborhood Watch is displayed on a public community center wall. Choice D correctly synthesizes this information to identify that both murals are displayed in public spaces accessible to community members, which is the key similarity between them.
